Prisma Access Agent 26.1.2 Known Issues

The following table lists the known issues in Prisma Access Agent 26.1.2.

Issue ID Description
PAA-5001 Agent may report incorrect connection status in the system tray on Windows.
PAA-5002 Auto-connect feature may not work after the device wakes from hibernation.
PAA-5003 Log collection may fail on systems with non-standard temp directory configurations.
